content: Create a hyper-cinematic 15-second continuous high-speed inline skating race video using Seedance 2.0. Use the provided character reference image for strict identity consistency. CHARACTER (STRICT LOCK) Female high-speed racer “Rabbit Racer”. Wears futuristic pink-white racing suit with mechanical bunny helmet, aerodynamic armor elements, and inline skates integrated with energy propulsion system. Skates glow with subtle neon energy core. Maintain exact design, helmet shape, outfit structure, and proportions throughout. STYLE Futuristic sci-fi racing anime × cinematic realism hybrid High-speed motion blur + sharp energy trail highlights Dynamic camera tracking with extreme acceleration perception Neon sci-fi lighting + reflective metallic environment Sport broadcast + cinematic drone hybrid visuals ENVIRONMENT (choose one below in prompt replacement section) Neo Gravity Circuit floating in sky city OR Underground magnetic speed tunnel OR Vertical sky city drop race track CAMERA LANGUAGE Ultra low-angle speed tracking along track surface High-speed drone follow with aggressive acceleration swings Fisheye lens during turns and jumps Close-up wheel/boot energy core ignition shots Motion streak emphasis on extreme velocity sections Occasional slow-motion micro bursts during high-force turns TIMELINE (15 SECONDS – HIGH SPEED RACE) 0s - 3s Start at race launch gate. Energy system activates. She launches forward instantly with extreme acceleration. Camera locks into ground-level chase. 3s - 6s High-speed straight track section. She overtakes energy competitors (blurred silhouettes). Inline skates emit neon propulsion trails. 6s - 9s Sharp gravity turn section. She leans into wall-ride curve, skating vertically on track surface with magnetic support. 9s - 12s Extreme jump transition. She jumps between floating track segments, mid-air rotation, energy burst trails visible. 12s - 15s Final sprint. Camera switches to front-facing chase. She accelerates directly toward lens at maximum speed → passes through camera in a violent motion blur exit. OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS Continuous race illusion (no cuts) Extreme speed perception priority Sci-fi inline racing physics No text, no logos, no subtitles No freeze frame ending (must continue motion) Emphasis on energy trails + acceleration feeling

Ella acelera directamente hacia la lente a máxima velocidad → pasa a través de la cámara en una salida de desenfoque de movimiento violento.
